subject: E-1285: quota exceeded on macOS
body:
Good morning. My setup is SyncVault 4.2.1, macOS 14.7. Since the weekend, every time I upload a
file, I get 'E-1285: storage quota exceeded'.

The plan was upgraded yesterday; the app still displays the old quota. The website shows the new
allowance correctly.

Before writing in I tried restarting the machine; same error afterwards.

Regards, Priya Nair, Harbour Freight
